methodology.description: Fundamentals-only scores remain unchanged. Sep 21 refresh updates the regime/action layer and latest verified prices where available: Malaysia closes through Sep 21 for YTLPOWR/MISC/HIBISCS, and latest completed US closes from Sep 18 for XOM/TTWO/TSLA. Creator transcripts do not change fundamental scores.

holdings.name: ExxonMobil
holdings.status: Best fundamental anchor · war-premium unwind validates no-chase discipline
metrics: 1.6286 shares · latest $163.54 Sep 18 · value $266.34 · transferred cost basis unavailable
Q2 operating cash flow: $23.6B
Watch: stabilize/reclaim $164–166; ~$169–170 repair; ~$176.4 larger breakout
holdings.strength: Strong integrated cash generation, advantaged upstream assets and refining exposure make XOM a higher-quality way to own the current energy scarcity regime.
holdings.weakness: War-premium crude is self-limiting if demand destruction or de-escalation arrives; do not treat every oil spike as permanent.
holdings.verdict: CORE HOLD / NO CHASE. Oil has retraced from the shock high; add only after price stabilizes and product/shipping stress remains confirmed.

holdings.name: MISC Berhad
holdings.status: Shipping macro supportive; price and Yinson funding still gate adds
metrics: 100 shares · avg RM8.30 · latest RM7.94 Sep 21 · value RM794 · P/L -RM36 (-4.34%)
Q2 revenue ~RM4.79B (+76% YoY); attributable profit ~RM1.15B (+149%)
Watch: RM7.90 area support · RM8.10–8.30 recovery · ~RM8.48 crucial reclaim
holdings.strength: Tanker-rate strength and diversified maritime assets are converting current energy/logistics disruption into earnings and cash flow.
holdings.weakness: Potential Yinson-related transaction funding, leverage and capital-allocation risk can overwhelm the otherwise strong operating tape.
holdings.verdict: HOLD. Record freight stress supports the operating backdrop, but do not add until price recovers and the Yinson structure/funding is clearer.

holdings.name: Hibiscus Petroleum Berhad
holdings.status: Oil beta cooling after war-premium unwind
metrics: 1,000 shares · avg RM2.10 · latest RM2.23 Sep 21 · value RM2,230 · P/L +RM130 (+6.19%)
FY26 net profit ~RM361M (+207%); record full-year dividend 10 sen/share
Watch: RM2.20 support · RM2.30–2.35 recovery · ~RM2.46 larger breakout
holdings.strength: Production scale, sharply improved FY26 earnings and direct crude-price sensitivity provide real cash-flow leverage to the current oil regime.
holdings.weakness: Field decline, decommissioning obligations, production interruptions and oil-price reversals keep this a higher-beta holding than XOM.
holdings.verdict: HOLD / NO CHASE. The crude premium is easing; protect the gain and require recovery/operating confirmation before adding.

holdings.name: YTL Power International Berhad
holdings.status: Tape repairing; contracted-load quality is now the key AI gate
metrics: 1,000 shares · avg RM3.83 · latest RM5.78 Sep 21 · value RM5,780 · P/L +RM1,950 (+50.91%)
Q4 revenue ~RM6.33B (+24% QoQ); PAT ~RM471M (+38% QoQ)
Watch: RM5.65–5.70 reclaimed · ~RM6.02 breakout · ~RM6.14 confirmation
holdings.strength: Power, regulated water, telecom, data-centre and cloud assets provide unusually broad exposure to Malaysia's physical AI buildout.
holdings.weakness: Heavy capex, leverage and concentration in the user's portfolio raise the hurdle for adding despite a strong structural theme.
holdings.verdict: HOLD / NO ADD. The tape repaired, but portfolio concentration and capex risk remain. Require ~RM6.02 plus evidence of contracted/funded load and utilisation before increasing conviction.

holdings.name: YTL Power structured warrant / linked instrument
holdings.status: Track parent only · standalone valuation unavailable
metrics: Rakuten: 200 units · no reliable displayed valuation
Fundamental score is inherited from parent YTLPOWR, not a standalone warrant valuation
Track parent levels: RM5.65–5.70 support · ~RM6.02 breakout · ~RM6.14 confirmation
holdings.strength: Economic direction is primarily linked to YTLPOWR's underlying thesis and price.
holdings.weakness: Warrant terms, expiry, strike, liquidity and time decay can dominate returns; a parent-company score is not a warrant valuation.
holdings.verdict: TRACK PARENT / INSTRUMENT STATUS. Do not infer a standalone target until reliable warrant terms and market price are available.

holdings.name: Take-Two Interactive Software
holdings.status: Elite franchise; prior reassessment line broken
metrics: Q1 FY2027 net bookings: $1.39B; recurrent spend 84% of revenue
Watch: ~$205 current zone · $210 first repair · $216–217 reclaim · $228–233 stronger recovery
holdings.strength: Exceptional IP and GTA VI scale potential can drive a large step-up in bookings and cash generation.
holdings.weakness: Current profitability/cash flow remain weak relative to valuation, and higher real yields raise the hurdle for catalyst-duration assets.
holdings.verdict: HOLD / NO ADD. The prior ~$210 reassessment line broke; require $216–217 recovery before treating the weakness as repaired.

holdings.name: Tesla
holdings.status: Tactical repair; valuation hurdle remains high
metrics: Storage remains the clearest current Power Stack earnings bridge
Watch: $353–355 support · $342–348 deeper · $375–383 repair · ~$397 next confirmation
holdings.strength: Exceptional balance sheet, energy storage growth and autonomy/robotics optionality create multiple paths to upside.
holdings.weakness: Core auto economics and valuation leave little room for execution disappointment, especially with real yields elevated.
holdings.verdict: HOLD / DO NOT AVERAGE DOWN. Price repaired from support but remains below $375–383; the high-rate valuation hurdle is unchanged.

holdings.name: Dayang Enterprise Holdings Berhad
holdings.status: Oil tailwind still lacks operating confirmation
metrics: 400 shares · avg RM1.81 · latest verified RM1.48 Sep 18 · value RM592 · P/L -RM132 (-18.23%)
Q2 revenue ~RM161M (-40% YoY); attributable profit ~RM32.8M (-57% YoY); order book ~RM4.72B
Watch: RM1.42 critical support · RM1.50–1.52 recovery · ~RM1.57 breakout
holdings.strength: Healthier balance sheet, sizeable order book and offshore maintenance/OSV exposure retain cyclical upside if utilisation and work orders recover.
holdings.weakness: Latest revenue/profit contraction and weaker vessel utilisation show that high oil prices have not yet translated into operating momentum.
holdings.verdict: HOLD / DO NOT AVERAGE DOWN. Require operating improvement and a sustained RM1.50–1.52 reclaim before fresh capital.
